title: McMistral
body:
Make your Minecraft world intelligent –
meet your AI companion!


[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow?style=flat)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![Platform: Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Fabric-lightgrey?style=flat)](https://fabricmc.net/) ![Side: Client](https://img.shields.io/badge/Side-Client-0074D9?style=flat)

---
## **Features**
### **Real AI Chat** **McMistral** integrates Mistral AI directly into your game. Ask about recipes, get survival tips, or just have a chat with your companion.
### **Full Game Context** The AI knows exactly what you are doing! It reads your real-time data: - **Coordinates & Facing Direction** (F3 debug data) - **Health, Hunger & Status Effects** - **Complete Inventory Contents**
### **Smart Commands** If you explicitly ask the AI to perform an action (e.g., *"Make it day"* or *"Give me a workbench"*), it executes the matching Minecraft command automatically. Simple questions remain text-only to prevent cheating.
### **Mod Compatibility** **Work in progress**: Thanks to Mixins, the AI automatically detects items and recipes from other mods installed in your modpack!
## **Setup** 1. Get an API key from the Mistral AI platform - https://admin.mistral.ai/organization/api-keys 2. In-game, type: `/mistral apikey ` 3. Chat with: `/mistral ask `
